description: The line plot illustrates the loss values over the number of iterations for five different models: Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128). The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," ranges from 0 to 140,000 with major tick marks at intervals of 20,000, representing the number of training iterations. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with major tick marks at intervals of 0.1, representing the model's loss value. All five lines start at a high loss value of approximately 3.3 at iteration 0 and exhibit a steep initial decline. The "Vanilla" model (purple line) shows the highest loss throughout, starting at 3.3 and decreasing to about 2.55 by iteration 140,000. The "StrmLLM (n=64)" (blue line) and "SepLLM (n=64)" (orange line) show very similar performance, both starting at 3.3 and converging to a loss of approximately 2.55. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" (green line) and "SepLLM (n=128)" (red line) also follow a similar trend, starting at 3.3 and converging to a loss of about 2.55. The "SepLLM (n=128)" line appears to be slightly lower than the "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" line towards the end of the iterations, indicating a marginally better performance.
